scope: Independent prototype performance optimization, formal detector unchanged

equivalence.scope: EventDetector.step only; alternated old/new order each real source frame; excludes decoding, ROS sync/publishing/logs; equivalence does not prove detection accuracy or realtime source coverage

static_count_semantics: Cumulative boxes are a false-positive proxy, not a measured false-positive rate
missing_output_semantics: Missing frozen output counts as a miss

actual_config.implementation: frame-input point-occlusion prototype; not full M-detector
actual_config.clustering: connected region growth of actual non-static points
actual_config.candidate_roi: world XY distance from current body position < 5m; no point Z clipping

process_cpu.endpoint: mapping_node process only; excludes rosbag, ROS master, audit subscriber, FAST-LIO, planner, and total machine load
process_cpu.percent_semantics: 100% is one logical CPU fully busy; process threads can exceed 100%.

entire_sampled_lifetime.phase_boundary_measurement: Tick counters linearly interpolated between 0.5-second samples; excludes any unsampled leading/trailing interval.

replay_phase.phase_boundary_measurement: Tick counters linearly interpolated between 0.5-second samples; excludes any unsampled leading/trailing interval.

memory.cpu_semantics: Process user plus system ticks; 100% means one fully busy logical CPU. Entire process and replay phase are scored separately.

audit.endpoint: raw-topic receipt at audit subscriber to state receipt at audit subscriber; includes synchronization and ROS transport

backlog_audit.endpoint: Actual audit subscriber monotonic receipt time, including synchronization and transport. Positive trend alone does not prove persistent callback accumulation.

config.implementation: frame-input point-occlusion prototype; not full M-detector
config.clustering: connected region growth of actual non-static points
config.candidate_roi: world XY distance from current body position < 5m; no point Z clipping

point_diagnostics.semantics: Every output has a current measured region. Nearby candidate reasons use a diagnostic 0.4m gate; the separate frozen geometry flag uses 0.25m/0.65m but does not prove bag receipt. Success rates must come from actual bag scoring. Continuous spans break on any unpublished callback or timestamp gap. Box counts remain a proxy, not true false-positive labels.

additional_box_provenance.semantics: Diagnostic one-to-one baseline box-center matching within 25cm; not net box increase or true false positives. Each source is verified against actual published center and size. Intervals end on any absent source input observation or phase change; last-minus-first spans are not physical occupancy duration.

frozen_candidate_geometry_audit.semantics: Annotations only select evaluator rows/geometry. Closest candidate is measured-center distance; eligible candidates use frozen <0.25m center and max size <0.65m. A nearby candidate does not prove physical ball identity. Nonpublished eligible category uses closest geometry-eligible candidate, preferring any eligible published candidate for publish category. Event/novelty deficiencies do not override the actual first rejection reason. No raw clouds, ROS or detector algorithm executed.
